verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's first-party docs name dedicated `window_width` and `window_height` parameters for changing the browser viewport when rendering the target page, and JavaScript rendering is on by default. The capability is directly documented, but only as a single sentence. Missing for 10: documented defaults, allowed value ranges and units for the parameters, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can control the browser viewport width and height when rendering a page

citations.quote: If you need to change the dimension of the browser's viewport (window) when scraping the target page you can use the `window_width` and `window_height` parameters.
JavaScript rendering is enabled by default.
